fusions.name: Antler Flick
fusions.desc: A hooking antler strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, then you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Flushed From Cover
fusions.desc: Looses 4 slivers of air, spread apart, each of which deals 5 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gone at a Sound
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a spot up to 7 tiles away, and your dodge chance rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Ears Already Turning
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that fails is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
